The verdict

For investors whose primary focus is passive income, the data show that the Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF remains the best option among widely followed dividend ETFs. Its annual expense ratio is also low, even though it's slightly higher than that one a top rival.

I wouldn't worry too much about the Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF's underperformance in total return over the last 10 years, either. The fund's total return isn't much lower than that of the iShares Core Dividend Growth ETF over the period. More importantly, Schwab's fund has delivered the highest total return of its peer group by far over the last 12 months.

Story Continues

The Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF is still what it has always been -- the dividend ETF that delivers attractive income with steady growth at a low cost. The data shows that it's still the best pick for income investors.

news.Title: The Stock Market Just Did Something for the First Time Ever. History Says Investors Should Be Worried. But Could This Time Be Different?
news.Content:
Long-time investors may think they've seen it all. However, they witnessed something just a couple of weeks ago that had never happened before in U.S. stock market history. The S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC) topped 7,750 for the first time. The widely followed index even briefly flirted with reaching the 7,800 mark. Although the S&P 500 has retreated slightly since then, it's still only about 2% below its all-time high.

Achieving this milestone is exciting. However, it could also be scary for many investors. Soaring valuations have accompanied the stock market's surge. History shows that investors should be worried when valuations become as frothy as they are now. But five words could be true that usually aren't: This time could be different.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Image source: Getty Images.

A worrisome first for the S&P 500?

Investors have become accustomed to the S&P 500 setting record highs in recent years. The index has skyrocketed more than 130% since the beginning of 2020. The stock market's sizzling performance is a reason for celebration. However, it's also a reason for caution.

While the S&P 500 has risen sharply, so has the benchmark valuation metric for the index: the S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio. CAPE stands for cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings ratio. Nobel laureate and economist Robert Shiller created the metric to measure the S&P 500's valuation by smoothing earnings multiples using a 10-year moving average and adjusting earnings for inflation.

The S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio has been higher than it is now only once before -- in late 1999 and early 2000. Soon after reaching that high, the stock market tanked as the dot-com bubble burst. Some believe the market is in an AI bubble now.

Another issue is how rapidly the CAPE ratio has risen. The previous times the metric has spiked to reach a record high include 1929, 2000, and 2021. The first of those years should be familiar: It's when the massive stock market crash that ushered in the Great Depression occurred. We've already discussed the 2000 market plunge. The S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio's surge in 2021 preceded the 2022 bear market.

S&P 500 Shiller CAPE Ratio data by YCharts

Why this time could be different

Some might roll their eyes when they hear anyone say that this time could be different for the stock market. People said that during the dot-com boom -- and things didn't end well then. However, there is a pretty good case to be made that this time really is different.

Story Continues

The centerpiece of this argument is simple: Earnings are growing significantly faster than stock prices. FactSet reported that, as of Aug. 28, 2026, with 97% of S&P 500 companies having reported second-quarter 2026 results, 86% reported a positive earnings per share (EPS) surprise. Furthermore, 77% of S&P 500 companies reported a positive revenue surprise. Overall, the S&P 500's earnings grew by 52%.

Earnings are growing so robustly that the S&P 500's forward price-to-earnings ratio now stands at 19.6, which is below the five-year average of 19.9. This could (and arguably should) make the surging S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio less frightening.

Granted, the contribution of the so-called "Magnificent Seven" stocks has been a big factor behind the S&P 500's earnings growth. In particular, investment gains for Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG) (NASDAQ:GOOGL) and Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) turbocharged their Q2 earnings results. Still, though, even excluding the two companies' one-time investment gains, S&P 500 net profit margins were 15.1%, the highest on record.

The quandary for investors

Investors may find themselves in a quandary. A sky-high S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio has been a reliable predictor of market downturns in the past. Caution certainly seems warranted, given the valuation metric's track record. On the other hand, S&P 500 earnings are growing so briskly that there appears to be more room for stocks to run.

What should investors do? I like Warren Buffett's approach. Buffett and his successor, Greg Abel, continue to be highly selective in how they deploy Berkshire Hathaway 's (NYSE:BRKA) (NYSE:BRKB) massive cash stockpile. But they are nonetheless finding some attractive stocks to buy, notably including Alphabet. I think that this strategy of watchful deliberation, combined with capitalizing on good opportunities, makes sense for all investors.

I'm not sure if this time truly is different than the past with respect to S&P 500 valuations. However, following Buffett's lead should enable investors to win over the long run either way.

news.Title: 3 Unstoppable Dow Stocks to Buy in September
news.Content:
September has averaged about a 0.7% loss in the S&P 500 index over the past 75 years, the worst showing of any month. That weakness has persisted through massive changes in market structure.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average tracks 30 industry leaders , making it a useful benchmark for identifying solid investments. Three components stand out as worth watching heading into the month.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

1. Home Depot

Home Depot (NYSE: HD) is the contrarian pick here. The stock has fallen about 19% over the past 12 months and sits near $327, down roughly 23% from its 52-week high of $426.75. That's unusual for a company some describe as delivering strong historical returns on the back of scale, operational excellence, and concise merchandising.

What makes September relevant is the interest rate cycle. Home Depot's business runs on housing turnover and large renovation projects, both of which have been frozen by elevated mortgage rates. Any easing shifts demand back toward professional customers, who make up the higher-ticket, higher-frequency side of the business. Home Depot has spent years building out through supply chain investments and its acquisition of SRS Distribution.

Return on invested capital still exceeds 21%, indicating the operating model has not broken down. It just seems that demand has paused. September's midterm housing push, alongside a potential rate cut, could influence consumer spending and, in turn, Home Depot's home-improvement demand and margins.

2. Visa

Visa (NYSE: V) trades near $379 and accounts for about 4% of the Dow. The seasonal data is instructive but honest: Visa's strongest documented window runs from mid-December through mid-March, beating the S&P 500 by an average of 3.8% in 15 of 17 years.

That matters for September because buying a stock ahead of a seasonally strong period is generally better than chasing it. Visa's business also does something useful in a weak month: It takes a small cut of payment volume regardless of what consumers buy or whether the market falls. Inflation raises transaction values, which mechanically increases Visa's revenue. There is no credit risk on the balance sheet because issuers hold the loans.

The growth story for Visa right now is about Visa Direct, tokenization, and the digitization of commercial payments rather than more traditional card swipes from everyday people. Visa Direct allows banks, businesses, and governments to move money to eligible cards, accounts, and wallets in near real time, expanding Visa's role well beyond the point of sale. Tokenization is another important piece, replacing sensitive card numbers with secure digital credentials that make online and mobile payments both safer and more seamless.

Story Continues

As these technologies gain adoption, Visa has more opportunities to capture payment volume and, in turn, more money. That gives Visa a relatively durable growth profile and makes the stock, in my view, a compelling long-term holding.

3. Procter & Gamble

Procter & Gamble (NYSE: PG) trades near $145 and yields roughly 3% after raising its dividend for 70 consecutive years. The payout ratio sits near 64%, so the company retains meaningful cash while returning about $10 billion annually to shareholders.

September is when defensive positioning tends to pay. P&G brands include Tide, Pampers, Gillette, Crest, and Bounty -- products people buy in every economic condition. Consumer staples historically hold up better than the market during drawdowns, and P&G is the anchor of that group. Recent results from the company showed core earnings per share (EPS) of $1.59 on revenue of $21.2 billion, both ahead of expectations, with growth spread across categories and regions rather than concentrated in one.

These three together are strong in September

So that's why these three stocks are excellent choices. Home Depot gives you a discounted cyclical with an identifiable catalyst. Visa gives you a toll booth on spending that benefits from inflation. Procter & Gamble gives you some ballast.

Seasonality describes a long-term tendency rather than a reliable short-term signal, and it can be overwhelmed by earnings and positioning in any given year. In other words, these aren't just September trades, but they are at a discount right now. These are Dow businesses that happen to be reasonably priced going into a month when people get nervous.

news.Title: 台積電全球狂蓋20座廠！5倍速狂飆仍遭搶爆 華爾街最新目標價曝光
news.Content:
台積電ADR周五（4日）收在428.91美元，上漲2.85%。隨著人工智慧（AI）需求持續激增，外資法人看好台積電後市，分析師共識維持「買進」評級，平均目標價達547.38 美元；以當前 ADR 股價計算，潛在漲幅高達近28%。為因應強勁產能需求，全球晶圓代工龍頭台積電正大幅調升設備採購預算，並在台灣與海外同步建廠加速擴充產能。

供應鏈緊繃連聯發科也急要產能

美國財經媒體Benzinga報導，台積電資深副總暨副共同營運長侯永清在SEMICON Taiwan論壇上表示，公司每季晶圓製造設備的採購預估，已提升至去年12月預估值的1.9 倍。《彭博》報導分析，此舉主要因應AI開發商需求大增，以及全球資料中心擴建潮，帶動先進製程晶片出貨攀升。

台積電目前於台灣及海外同步進行約20座廠房的興建與設備裝機，規模遠超以往同時推動4至5 座新廠的紀錄，然而，快速擴產也帶來營造人力吃緊等考驗。侯永清坦言：「現在幾乎得以4 至5倍的速度追趕，但仍無法滿足需求。」

台積電董事長魏哲家先前表示，公司將持續縮小晶片供給與需求之間的落差。包括輝達（NVIDIA）與超微（AMD）等主要客戶仍不斷追加訂單，使產能維持高壓狀態。輝達目前先進AI晶片全數交由台積電代工，並預期明年營收持續大幅成長。

產能受限的況狀也影響其他晶片設計大廠，聯發科執行長蔡力行在論壇上直接向侯永清喊話：「Cliff，我可以拿到更多產能嗎？」顯示出半導體產業供需失衡現狀。

華爾街投研機構重申目標價

台積電在台股表現方面，4日上漲20 元、收在2410 元；美股部分，台積電ADR周五（5日）上漲2.85%，收在428.91 美元。市場交易人士指出，目前ADR股價正測試429.50美元壓力價位，若突破有機會挑戰前高；下方支撐則落在405.50美元附近。

華爾街法人持續給予台積電正面評級。美股投研機構Stifel近期首度將台積電納入研究範圍，給予「買進」評級與515美元目標價；伯恩斯坦（Bernstein）與Needham也分別維持「優於大盤」及「買進」評級，目標價最高上看554美元、530美元。

儘管目前本益比約30.9 倍，反映市場給予優質企業的估值溢價，外資分析師平均目標價仍達 547.38 美元，凸顯對其長線成長動能的肯定。

news.Title: 台指夜盤先破47K！外資狂補562億 分析師：真突破還缺這一塊
news.Content:
台股上周五（4日）大漲693.47點、收46,551.13點，盤中最高46,620.96點；三大法人更從3日賣超637.11億元，一口氣翻為買超628.72億元，兩個交易日買賣差額達1,265.83億元，其中外資單日回補562.13億元。

但另一項數字卻沒有一起衝高：成交值從3日9,462.71億元降至4日8,256.26億元。

量縮到底好不好？分析師看法一次看

摩爾投顧分析師張貽程指出，4日大盤上漲693點但量能縮減，市場仍在等待後續通膨數據，因此近期未必立即出現大量，盤面可能先以個股、族群表現為主；他認為，台股有台積電、聯發科及金融股支撐，走勢未必完全跟隨費半。

不過，倫元投顧分析師陳學進則保守指出，47,000至48,000點仍是主要反壓區，4日量能明顯縮減顯示追價力道不足，若後續能「放量突破47K」，多頭訊號才會更加明確；否則短線仍應視為反彈、震盪與輪動格局。

新光投顧也持類似觀察，指數下一步先看46,600點附近能否突破，若成交量同步回升、台積電(2330)守穩2,400元，才有機會進一步挑戰47,000點。

非農爆出16.2萬人 費半卻逆勢走自己的路

週末（4日）最大的變數則已揭牌，美國8月非農新增16.2萬人，遠高於市場原估約5.5~5.6萬人，失業率維持4.1%，升息預期隨之升高，美股三大指數收黑。

台新投顧總經理黃文清指出，這份非農報告拿掉了「勞動市場失去動能」這個反對升息的重要理由，但尚不足以直接決定9月升息，真正決勝點已轉向下周公布的CPI；若通膨再高於預期，升息機率將明顯提高。

有趣的是，科技資金並未全面退潮，半導體股逆勢走強，台指期夜盤最終收47,182點、上漲473點，台積電期貨也漲20元，期貨市場已先越過47,000點。

外資買562億 期貨空單仍居高不下

這也讓週一第三項訊號更加重要：外資到底是不是「真的翻多」。

群益期貨指出，外資4日現貨雖大買562億元，但台指期淨空單反而增加至82,389口，選擇權籌碼也偏保守，因此整體期現貨布局仍不能解讀為全面偏多。

本土投顧也認為，若外資回補能配合量能放大，才有利台股挑戰47,000點，同時仍須防範高檔波動擴大。

雖然夜盤已替多方先推開47K的大門，但46,620.96點能否守住、成交量能否回升，以及外資562億元買盤能不能續航，才是這道門能不能真正站穩的關鍵。

news.Title: 下周大軋空噴2千點？專家預言「這天」漲破48000 曝5大主流必買飆股
news.Content:
受美股費半指數暴漲逾 3% 激勵，台股夜盤期貨同步狂飆473點、收在 47182點。專家指出，台股在下周有極大機會發動「大軋空」暴噴2000點，並一舉突破48000點歷史新高，關鍵時間點約落在周四、周五，建議投資人特別留意五大AI關鍵族群與潛力標的。

10月起更將進一步挑戰61000點

摩爾投顧分析師江國中指出，下周台股有極大機會出現2000點大軋空行情，大盤一旦噴出將達 48500點，直接越過48000點歷史新高。從均線結構觀察，預估最晚在下周四至周五，30 日均線（MA30）將正式突破 60 日均線（MA60）；當20、30、60 日均線形成大多頭排列，台股將順勢創高。

江國中強調，台指期在本周已領先越過47312點的關鍵轉折值（本周最高達47343 點），一旦9 月站穩該點位，突破48000 點後將開啟月線大長紅。進入第四季，特別是10月起，台股更將進一步挑戰61000點至61481點的轉折預告值。

五大AI族群點燃軋空火種

隨著台股均線大多頭排列即將成型，江國中點名五大 AI 產業焦點：

◆CPO（共同封裝光學／矽光子）：被認定為未來數年必備超級大主流，台積電已證實明年矽光子在伺服器的傳輸比重將大幅躍升至50%。上游材料以聯亞為指標飆股，一個月內大漲一倍以上，後市持續看好，全新、環宇同步受惠；中游光模組與晶片的華星光近期強勢噴出漲停，光聖、眾達、波若威、聯鈞等表現亮眼；CPO封測與檢測的上詮、汎銓也展現強勢動能。

◆被動元件（MLCC）：受惠AI帶動MLCC用量暴增5至8倍，特殊規格單價大漲。其中華新科訂單出貨比（B/B Ratio）達1.8，低檔整理完畢蓄勢待發；國巨訂單出貨比高達2.0，為直接受惠指標；日電貿、雷科則為供需結構轉緊的低檔連動受益股。

記憶體與IP迎重新估值行

◆散熱族群：AI 運算必備「電、光、熱」協同運作，散熱指標股拉開漲幅空間，呈現強勢主升段起漲格局。雙鴻一周大漲 39%，展現標準主升段起漲型態；健策具備「三率三升」基本面優勢，波段獲利豐厚；奇鋐基本面極佳，股價刷新歷史新高；高力也強勢噴出。

◆記憶體族群：美股周五（4日）記憶體指標大漲，海力士漲8%、美光漲6%及SanDisk飆11%，帶動產業回溫，相關個股均線與指標並未背離。南亞科、華邦電目前皆處於日、周線的低檔紅色多頭軌道支撐區，不應在震盪時隨意殺低，未來仍看好創高。

◆AI晶片與IP重估：聯發科與輝達強強聯手，已成功從手機晶片轉型為高毛利的「矽智財（IP）」公司，迎來法人本益比重新估值（Re-rating）。外資大摩與高盛看好其2028年後年 EPS挑戰300至427元，長線極具爆發力，若以25倍本益比來估算，未來幾年後確實有機會上看萬元。

news.Title: 欣興1230殺到873 還失去什麼？家登董座批「吃飽沒事幹」應驗張忠謀一字警惕
news.Content:
PCB大廠欣興爆出涉嫌洗產地與貼牌風波，引發業界高度關注。家登董事長邱銘乾日前直言，台廠能賺大錢是因獲得西方客戶信任，「還洗產地，吃飽沒事幹？」。對此，財信傳媒董事長謝金河表示，邱銘乾的說法呼應台積電創辦人張忠謀曾強調的成功核心「Trust（信任）」，若台廠玩掉信任，傷害將擴及整體產業。

家登董座批「還洗產地，吃飽沒事幹！」

欣興遭檢調搜索約談後，股價從 1230 元一路下挫至873 元。謝金河在臉書發文指出，這家績優ABF載板廠除了面臨股價下跌與股東損失，受創最深的是公司治理形象，以及市場對其累積的信賴。

事件發生第一時間，家登董事長邱銘乾接受採訪時表示，台廠今天能賺大錢，全靠西方長年累積的信任，「還洗產地，吃飽沒事幹！」。他強調，台灣在全球供應鏈站穩腳步，廠商絕不能做出讓客戶感覺被出賣的事，若台廠玩掉這份信任，受傷害的絕不只是單一企業。

謝金河回憶，過去與台積電創辦人張忠謀餐敘時，曾詢問台積電成功的核心要素，張忠謀當時僅回答「Trust（信任）」一個字。如今邱銘乾董事長這一席話可以直接呼應張創辦人。

台美貿易順差創高 台廠切勿玩兩面手法

謝金河進一步解釋，所謂的西方信任主要指美國，若失去美國信任，台灣不會有今日榮景。數據顯示，台灣7月對美國貿易順差達207億美元；今年前7月台灣對美國出口1556.52億美元，進口341.9億美元，貿易順差高達1224.62億美元，台灣成為美國的大逆差國。

過去台灣出口最大市場在大陸，最高占比達 43.9%，如今降至24%；對美國出口占比則從11.7% 上升至 31.8%，主要推手來自AI產業，使台灣成為美國關鍵的AI供應鏈夥伴，信賴元素因而格外重要。

謝金河強調，在美中角力深化背景下，美國對大陸採取堅壁清野策略，台廠不能玩兩面手法，一方面與美國做生意，另一方面又將違禁產品出口至大陸，或將大陸製造的產品貼上台灣標籤賣往美國。

他指出，近年許多印刷電路板大廠生產基地都在大陸，例如楠梓電將產能移至滬電股份，臻鼎旗下有鵬鼎，定穎旗下有超穎，欣興在昆山、蘇州與黃石也有十多個生產基地。台廠如何妥善規範產能、避免洗產地，已成為當前重要課題。

news.Title: 台股下周爆噴500點？費半狂飆3％、台積ADR暴漲 全因川普一句話
news.Content:
美國8月非農就業報告意外強勁，美股周五（4日）三大指數因升息疑慮收黑，但與台股連動緊密的費城半導體指數逆勢上漲逾 3%，在晶片股帶動下，台指期夜盤上漲 473點，台積電期貨上漲20元，台股下周一（7日）有機強漲500點，衝破47000點大關。

川普喊話降息施壓聯準會

美國勞工統計局公布，8月非農就業人口增加16.2萬人，高於預估的5.6萬人；7 月數據由原先減少2.3 萬人上修至增加2.1萬人，失業率維持在4.1%。就業數據促使市場重新評估聯準會利率政策，CME FedWatch 顯示，9 月升息1碼的機率由前一日的 49.4%升至約60%。

市場焦點轉向9月10日公布的生產者物價指數（PPI）與11日的消費者物價指數（CPI），通膨結果將是聯準會（Fed）升息或按兵不動的關鍵，最終在9 月15日至16日的FOMC利率會議定奪。

儘管非農數據遠超預期，美國總統川普仍要求聯準會降息至1%或更低。他表示，就業數據表現佳本應帶動股市，市場卻因通膨疑慮下跌；並揚言，若Fed不降息，可能停止與對美國存在貿易順差的國家進行貿易。

受升息疑慮壟罩，美股周五承壓，道瓊工業指數下跌271點（0.51%），收在 53414 點；那斯達克指數下跌77點（0.29%），收在26506 點；標普500指數下跌29點（0.38%），收在7718點。

美晶片股逆勢上漲 台股周一多頭再點火

降息有助降低營運成本並拉高成長股評價，對晶片股帶來正面助益。相較於大盤疲軟，半導體族群逆勢成為盤面焦點，費城半導體指數大漲 383 點（3.37%），收在 11735 點。其中輝達上漲 0.84%，超微與應用材料上漲逾 4%，美光暴漲 6.10%，台積電 ADR 也上漲 2.85%。

晶片股走揚激勵台指期夜盤上漲473點（1.01%），收在47182點；台積電期貨上漲 20元收在2433 元，預期台股下周一（7日）將持續挑戰 47000點大關。

回顧台股4日加權指數收在46551 點，大漲693 點（1.51%），成交金額8256 億元。三大法人合計買超616.7億元，其中外資終止連二賣轉為買超562億元，掃貨標的包括國巨、鴻海、緯創及台積電。

富邦投顧董事長陳奕光分析，從時間轉折點推算，台股於9月16日進入第34天轉折，指數有機會挑戰前高47395點，10月16日則有機會上看歷史高點48218點。

news.Title: 郭恭克專欄》台股後市基本面仍強、資金重新回流 第四季偏多但高檔震盪難免
news.Content: 出口強勁，台灣經濟基本面仍是最大支撐。出口與進口同步高速成長，尤其進口增幅高，主要反映半導體設備、電子零組件及AI相關資本財需求旺盛。（攝影／鄭國強） 截至2026年9月首周，台股基本面仍維持高度景氣擴張格局。出口、AI資本支出、半導體產業鏈與國內資金水位形成多頭支柱，但台股經歷大幅上漲後，估值過高疑慮升高、外資短線調節、美元與美債殖利率波動，以及中東地緣政治風險，均可能造成短線劇烈震盪。台股長期趨勢仍偏多，惟操作上應避免在震盪走勢中過度情緒反應，造成追高殺低。 出口強勁，台灣經濟基本面仍是最大支撐。2026年7月台灣出口達753.0億美元，年增32.9%；進口581.3億美元，年增37.4%。前7月出口累計4,919.5億美元、年增44.7%，進口3,773.4億美元、年增39.8%，貿易順差達1,146.1億美元。出口與進口同步高速成長，尤其進口增幅高，主要反映半導體設備、電子零組件及AI相關資本財需求旺盛，並非單純內需進口增加。 圖、我國對外出口及長短期趨勢 更值得注意的是，AI需求仍在擴散至伺服器、ASIC、先進封裝、HBM、散熱、電源、PCB及光通訊等供應鏈，因此台灣出口高成長仍具產業結構性基礎。只要全球雲端服務商持續擴大AI基礎建設，台股企業獲利向上的趨勢仍有延續空間。 表、我國出口貨品結構表 但比出口數據更值得注意的是外銷訂單。7月外銷訂單達979.4億美元，創歷年同期新高，月增2.8%、年增61.9%；前7月累計6,020.3億美元，較去年同期增加2,073.6億美元，年增達52.5%。換言之，台灣企業接到的未來訂單成長速度甚至高於當期出口，意味未來數月生產、出貨及營收仍具有高度能見度。 表、台灣各月外銷接單統計表 (資料期間：2024年6月至2026年7月)

news.Title: 台股熱絡詐團伸魔手　詐騙廣告季增970件
news.Content:
台股行情熱絡，投資詐騙廣告量出現回彈跡象。金管會最新統計，今(2026)年第2季通報Google、Meta下架的疑似投資詐騙廣告達6,194件，較第1季5,223件增加971件、季增18.6%，中止先前連續4季下降走勢，也是去(2025)年第1季以來首度出現單季反彈，引起主管機關關注。

若拉長時間觀察，目前整體詐騙廣告量仍低於去年高峰。2025年第1季通報1萬3,676件，第2季1萬1,588件、第3季7,923件、第4季5,562件，今年首季進一步降至5,223件，第2季彈升至6,194件。合計今年上半年有1萬1,417件，較去年同期減少約54.8%。

金管會表示，已經注意到今年第2季通報件數上升，也擔心可能與近期台股劇烈波動、投資熱度升高有關，已請證交所等相關單位加強蒐集及通報。不過，單一季度數據不足以判定趨勢反轉，後續仍待觀察。

目前常見投資詐騙手法集中在4大類型。第1類，透過電話、簡訊或LINE群組，以推薦飆股、分享投資經驗及高額獲利等話術，吸引民眾加入群組；第2類，誘導下載假投資平台或App，宣稱可搶漲停股票、特殊管道下單或保證獲利。

第3類，冒用合法券商、投信、金融機構或財經專家名義招攬投資；第4類，透過虛擬通貨交易平台，以高收益、高報酬為誘因，鼓吹民眾投入虛擬貨幣或來路不明的交易平台。

值得注意的是，網路詐騙廣告雖然止跌回升，但民眾向金管會陳情的投資詐騙案件並未同步上揚。2023年陳情787件、2024年升至941件、2025年向下跌至512件，今年前4月則有132件。

金管會自2023年起，與Google、Meta及相關部會建立投資詐騙廣告蒐報機制，將疑似違法招攬、冒名金融機構或名人的廣告通報平台下架。面對通報量重新抬頭，將持續強化蒐報與監控，避免詐騙集團趁市場熱度增溫之際，藉投資題材違法吸金。

news.Title: 台股強彈收復5日線 日KD高檔背離風險未解? 股票不賣飛! 三大停利策略教學
news.Content:
美股受聯準會理事華勒釋出鴿派談話激勵，隔夜出現反彈，也帶動台股周五（4）走強，早盤雖然一度開高走低，但10點後逐步反彈，終場收復5日均線，本週上漲219點，連續第2週收紅，不過成交量僅約8557億元，創近1週新低。但受惠半導體展，不只電子、AI、金融等族群表現亮眼，台積電、聯發科走強，富邦金也創下歷史新高；電腦周邊、工具機及光電族群也同樣受到市場資金關注。但另一方面，美伊衝突持續升溫，國際油價維持高檔，布蘭特原油一度逼近每桶96美元，避險資金也流入黃金市場；市場擔心油價上漲可能推升通膨，進一步影響聯準會後續利率政策。聯準會9月是否升息？市場目前主要關注非農就業與CPI數據；專家提醒近期台股雖然表現相對強勢，但技術面已出現KD指標頂背離，投資人仍須留意修正風險，投資人該採取何種操作策略，才能有效兼顧獲利與後續上漲空間？來聽專家怎麼說。

news.Title: 外媒封台積電「AI終極贏家」！ 10大必買股曝光 網笑了
news.Content: 當全球科技巨頭為AI展開瘋狂軍備競賽，誰才是淘金潮中穩賺不賠的最大贏家？比起陷入激烈廝殺的模型開發商與晶片巨頭，掌握代工命脈的台積電被外媒譽為終極勝者，然而這頂桂冠能否轉化為實質股價報酬，引發熱烈激辯。 隨著生成式人工智慧浪潮白熱化，市場多數目光聚焦在輝達身上，但美國財經媒體《Motley Fool》近日分析指出，這場AI軍備競賽的最大受惠者可能另有其人，分析提到無論是OpenAI還是Anthropic等AI模型開發先鋒，未來誰能笑到最後仍充滿未知數，輝達與超微（AMD）等無晶圓廠IC設計業者固然能分得一杯羹，但將眼光放大至整體硬體供應鏈時，晶圓代工龍頭台積電反而展現出無可取代的獨特優勢。 報導分析，輝達與AMD雖然負責頂尖架構設計，但實體晶片的製造完全仰賴代工廠的產能，台積電不僅坐擁全球最先進的製程工藝，去年更囊括全球晶圓代工市場高達72%的營收版圖，更關鍵的是，台積電具備同時替多家競爭對手代工的中立優勢，只要各大科技巨頭持續拉高AI相關的資本支出，台積電就能雨露均霑。加上台積電董事長魏哲家先前曾明確表態，AI相關晶片的強勁需求預估將一路延續至2029年甚至2030年，《Motley Fool》因而將台積電比擬為AI基礎建設的核心支柱。 ▼美國財經媒體《Motley Fool》將台積電比擬為AI基礎建設的核心支柱。（示意圖／東森新聞資料照） 然而當這篇盛讚報導被轉貼至網路論壇 PTT 後，眼尖的網友卻立即抓包了文章背後的大亮點，原PO深入翻查《Motley Fool》的原文赫然發現，該媒體雖然在文章內文把台積電捧為AI浪潮中最穩健的投資標的之一，但文末順帶宣傳自家付費投資服務「Stock Advisor」所列出的「當前最值得買進的10檔股票」名單時，台積電竟然完全榜上無名。這般自相矛盾的現象讓網友紛紛調侃「終極贏家但我不推薦買」、「賣鏟子會賺大錢」。 ▼掌握代工命脈的台積電被外媒譽為終極勝者。（示意圖／翻攝自台積電官網）

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》地緣政治與戰略資源—TSM、INTC、MU
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-04 15:54:32 數位內容中心 發佈

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company（TSM.US）

美國商務部長於本週將半導體關稅與在美投資直接綁定，並點名Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company在亞利桑那州興建2,650億美元廠區。報導同時指出，未來可能依赴美投資規模，給予部分晶片免稅輸美額度。

Intel（INTC.US）

SK海力士本週評估將第7代高頻寬記憶體（HBM）基底晶粒交由Intel晶圓代工生產，最快自HBM4E開始。這項評估把Intel放進下一代HBM供應鏈候選名單，也對應美國推動本土製造與非台系分散化方向。

Micron Technology（MU.US）

美國商務部長本週將Micron Technology列為關稅驅動製造回流的代表案例，並指出公司投入2,500億美元建置記憶體工廠。若與台積電亞利桑那州投資合計，兩者已超過5,000億美元，記憶體被明確放進美國戰略半導體核心。

Navitas Semiconductor（NVTS.US）

Navitas Semiconductor本週完成並交付在美國製造的第5代氮化鎵電源晶片，生產來自GlobalFoundries佛蒙特州200毫米產線，且結合CHIPS and Science Act資金。事件重點不在單一產品，而是AI資料中心電力半導體正式往美國本土化推進。

GlobalFoundries（GFS.US）

GlobalFoundries本週以佛蒙特州Burlington的200毫米氮化鎵矽上製程線，支援Navitas交付第5代GaNFast電源晶片。原始資料指出，AI伺服器機櫃耗電已達100至120千瓦，讓美國本土功率半導體產線直接連上AI基礎設施需求。

MP Materials（MP.US）

美國國防部自去年7月對MP Materials投資4億美元後，該股累計上漲87%，但政府入股後5週內一度飆升逾150%，隨後一年回落近27%。本週訊號在於稀土供應鏈已明顯出現國防資本直接介入與重估。

Trilogy Metals（TMQ.US）

美國政府本週同意取得Trilogy Metals10%股權，並同步核准阿拉斯加道路計畫；原始資料指出，這條道路被視為進入其採礦權區域的必要基礎設施。事件把關鍵礦物開發重點，從單一礦權推向道路與政府支持的整體條件。

news.Title: 【台股盤後】權值股回神、國巨漲停　台股終場上揚693點收復5日線
news.Content:
（中央社記者江明晏台北2026年9月4日電）台股今天開高震盪，終場勁揚693.47點，收在46551.13點，站回5日線關卡；權值股回神，聯發科漲1.73%，國巨亮燈鎖漲停，領軍被動元件股衝鋒，散熱股、AI伺服器股強勢。

投顧分析，台股有AI基本面強力需求支撐，但後續有美國貨幣政策變數，估短期指數高檔區間震盪。

華爾街股市主要指數收高，亞股強勢，台股今天以45991點開高，盤中最高至46620點，上漲763點，隨後漲勢收斂，終場仍站回5日線約46330點。

台股加權指數終場收在46551.13點，上漲693.47點，漲幅1.51%，成交值新台幣8256.26億元；本週上漲219.68點。電子指數漲1.63%，金融指數漲1.17%；代表中小型股的櫃買OTC指數上漲1.83%。

觀察權值股表現，聯發科終場上漲1.73%，收4415元；台積電上漲20元，收在2410元，漲幅0.84%；台達電漲3.69%，聯電漲4%。

指標股方面，記憶體族群南亞科、華邦電收漲約3%；緯創、華碩漲逾5%；載板族群欣興、南電、臻鼎-KY收黑，景碩強漲逾5%。

被動元件強勢，國巨領軍衝鋒，尾盤亮燈漲停鎖住，大毅、華新科、禾伸堂、金山電收漲停，立隆電、日電貿、信昌電、鈺邦等強漲逾8%。散熱股奇鋐漲逾8%，雙鴻漲停。

觀察高價股走勢，股王信驊疲軟、股后川湖漲逾3%，大立光漲3.5%，收7400元，登上台股第3高價股，玉晶光、華碩再度登上千元關卡，台股收盤坐擁49千金股。

台新投顧總經理黃文清向中央社記者表示，台股近期震盪，主要受到美國貨幣政策不確定性影響，市場對聯準會（Fed）9月升息與否看法分歧，機率約各半，後續公布的非農就業數據及消費者物價指數（CPI）將成為關鍵觀察指標。

他表示，台股基本面仍有AI需求支撐，預期8月營收維持高成長，加上半導體展帶來的利多激勵，推升指數反彈；不過，上有貨幣政策不確定性的「鍋蓋」壓抑，下有AI基本面支撐，預期台股短期仍將維持區間震盪，指數約在45000點至48000點間整理。

news.Title: 科技巨頭投資聯發科　宏碁陳俊聖：台廠成全球AI資本根基
news.Content:
（中央社記者吳家豪柏林2026年9月4日電）科技巨頭輝達（NVIDIA）與Google日前宣布投資認購聯發科 (2454) 海外可轉換公司債（ECB）。電腦品牌廠宏碁 (2353) 董事長暨執行長陳俊聖表示，海外大廠注資聯發科等台廠，凸顯台灣已不只是全球科技強權與製造重鎮，更躍居全球人工智慧（AI）發展的「資本根基」。

宏碁轉投資的的包租代管業者兆基日前傳出經營爭議，宏碁接掌2天後即撤出經營層。陳俊聖表示，宏碁秉持「自我防衛」原則，需避免風險擴大、對股東有所交代，同時支持兆基新團隊穩住營運，兼顧社會穩定。

陳俊聖在德國柏林出席next@acer全球發表會接受媒體採訪，中央社記者提問對海外大型科技業者近期投資聯發科等台灣供應鏈的看法。陳俊聖觀察，近期包括台積電 (2330) 、聯發科等供應鏈大廠，紛紛透過發債或增資方式籌措資金，背後關鍵在於，台灣已成為全球AI發展進程中的資本根基。

他分析，當生意做得越大、產業規模持續擴張，所需的營運週轉資金就越多；市場對資本有高度需求，對台灣而言絕非壞事，代表整體產業實力更強。

另一方面，針對宏碁轉投資的兆基日前傳出爭議，陳俊聖指出，兆基已改由王貴增出任董事長，宏碁對此表達支持；王貴增上任後首要任務是穩住內部營運，並改善與銀行團的關係，「他是以個人對銀行團做連帶保證，這是相當重要的承諾」，後續王貴增也預計增加持股，確保業務持續運轉。

陳俊聖說，今年初兆基增資時宏碁並未參與，股權被稀釋，目前宏碁持有兆基股份比率約17%，維持1席董事，暫無擴大持股的計畫。

陳俊聖表示，兆基平台服務2萬多名租客與數千名房東，兆基的穩定發展，對台灣社會的穩定有積極效果，因此宏碁能夠做的時候盡量做，「不能做的話，誰能做我們就盡量支持他」，宏碁關注的重心仍在於兆基本業穩定經營。

news.Title: 《陸股》滬指漲0.02%、惟日K連二黑；科創50跌0.4%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-03 17:07:08 數位內容中心 發佈

中國A股主要指數今(3)日震盪收漲，上證指數收於3942.09點，上漲0.02%，惟日K連二黑；深證成指收於13625.12點，上漲0.10%；創業板指收於3312.54點，上漲0.01%；科創50指數收於1611.17點，下跌0.40%。盤勢維持小幅分化，資金主要在液冷、大金融與部分題材類股間輪動。

成交量方面，滬市今成交8,199億元(人民幣,下同)，深市成交9,390億元，兩市成交額1兆7,589億元，較前一交易日量縮約2%。

從盤面上來看，液冷概念持續走強，集泰股份以漲停姿態領漲，已出現連4根漲停板，思泉新材、鴻富瀚等也跟進表現。市場對液冷與電源產業鏈的訂單確認、備貨與排產節奏關注升溫，AI伺服器出貨成長也帶動相關族群熱度。

此外，大金融同步活躍，券商與保險族群領漲，國盛證券盤中漲停，長江證券、廣發證券表現居前。培育鑽石、航運與零售族群接力走強，恒盛能源、黃河旋風、中遠海能等個股表現活躍。相較之下，農業、糧食概念持續回調，種植、養殖、豬肉與乳業等族群偏弱，顯示盤勢仍以題材輪動為主。

個股分化方面，高檔人氣股承壓，傳智教育、一鳴食品等跌停，反映資金持續從高檔題材撤出。整體來看，A股今日指數變動不大，但類股強弱分明，市場焦點仍集中在液冷與金融等相對強勢族群。

news.Title: 【Follow法人】記憶體又成提款機？外資砍南亞科華邦電逾6萬張 反手買台積電235億元
news.Content:
（下午4點50分更新買賣超個股）

台股今（3）日震盪走低，終場下跌307點，失守4萬6千點關卡。三大法人合計賣超637.11億元，其中外資今日再賣超481.45億元，呈現連2賣，兩日累計提款1,394.99億元。資深台股分析師蔡明翰表示，外資近期賣超主要反映台股位階相對偏高，法人目前仍處於觀望、多空分歧階段。觀察個股，記憶體再成提款重災區，南亞科（2408）、華邦電（2344）合計遭砍逾6萬張；台積電（2330）則逆勢獲外資加碼235億元。

外資今日賣超前三大：00981A、南亞科、華邦電

外資今日賣超以主動統一台股增長（00981A）居冠，單日遭調節逾3.8萬張；記憶體股南亞科（2408）遭外資砍逾3.4萬張排名第二；華邦電（2344）則遭賣超逾2.6萬張，位居第三。

值得注意的是，記憶體族群成為外資今日主要提款對象，除了南亞科、華邦電包辦第二、三名外，力積電（6770）、旺宏（2337）也分別遭賣超約1.9萬張及1.5萬張，前十大賣超榜中共有4檔記憶體相關個股入列。

ETF同樣遭到外資調節，除了賣超冠軍主動統一台股增長外，大華優利高填息30（00918）、群益台灣精選高息（00919）、主動凱基台灣（00407A）及復華台灣科技優息（00929）也擠進前十大，前十大賣超榜共有5檔ETF入列。

外資今日買超前三大：友達、遠東銀、兆豐金

觀察外資今日買超個股，面板股友達（2409）以買超逾5.5萬張高居第一，遠東銀（2845）獲外資買超近3萬張排名第二，兆豐金（2886）則獲加碼逾2.3萬張，位居第三。

外資今日買盤也明顯集中金融股，除了遠東銀、兆豐金外，國票金（2889）、合庫金（5880）、元大金（2885）及第一金（2892）也進入前十大，前十大買超個股中共有6檔金融股。

其餘個股方面，晶圓代工廠聯電（2303）獲外資買超逾2.2萬張；另一檔面板股群創（3481）也獲加碼逾1.9萬張。值得注意的是台積電（2330）也獲外資買超9,838張，若以今日收盤價估算，外資單日加碼金額約235億元。

外資連2賣是轉空？蔡明翰：高檔正常調節

蔡明翰指出，台股前波一度逼近4萬7千點，準備挑戰歷史高點，相較之下，與台股連動度較高的費城半導體指數及韓股仍處整理階段，台股位階明顯較高，因此外資近期出現獲利調節並不意外，他認為，目前整體格局仍是在消化上半年大漲後的漲幅，趨勢尚未出現明顯改變。

至於外資何時可能重新轉為連續買超？蔡明翰認為，關鍵仍要觀察美國科技股，以費城半導體指數為主，若費半重新站回月線、趨勢逐步轉強，資金重新回流科技及AI族群，屆時才較有機會看到外資轉為較具連續性的買超，台股也才有進一步向上挑戰的空間。

蔡明翰指出，目前法人並非明顯偏多或偏空，而是處於觀望階段，後續仍須等待美國科技股轉強，才有機會看到法人資金出現較具持續性的回流。

外資再砍481億元 三大法人合計賣超637億元

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日合計賣超637.11億元。其中，外資今日再砍481.45億元，呈連2賣，累計賣超1,394.99億元。

其中投信則是逆勢買超，投信今日由賣轉買，合計買超11.41億元。自營商則持續賣超167.06億元，其中自行買賣買超56.78億元，避險操作賣超110.28億元。

台股今日震盪走低，加權指數終場收在45,857點，下跌307點，失守4萬6千點關卡。成交金額約9,892億元；權王台積電（2330）終場收在2,390元，上漲5元。

湯暖萱／財經特派記者，主跑主計處、營建、百貨紡織等

news.Title: 韓股尾盤震盪急殺，終場翻揚小漲0.26%，半導體關稅疑慮壓抑科技股
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美股上日翻揚，加上油價未再追高，帶動前一交易日急殺3.99%、淪為全球表現最差主要股指的韓國股市週四強勢反彈。首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)跳空高開1.3%，盤中最多上漲1.8%至6,682.97點日高，但收盤前一小時東亞股市同遭賣壓打擊，賣盤驟增，指數自日高急挫243.48點，摜破6,500點至6,439.49點日低，終場在部份類股吸納買盤下仍倒升16.76點或0.26%，收在6,579.48點。類股表現分歧，營建、電力天然氣及運輸設備類股吸引資金進駐，成為大盤由黑翻紅的主要支撐。主流電子股下滑0.53%，三星電子和SK海力士各跌0.20%和1.05%，三星電機急挫3.71%為三十檔大型股(KTOP)最大魯蛇。醫療與精密設備、電信及紡織成衣類股依序下跌1.13%、1.38%及1.55%，構成盤面三大賣壓中心。

半導體關稅疑慮持續壓抑科技股。韓國總統府青瓦台週四表示，美國政府考慮推出新一輪進口半導體關稅，但具體內容尚未敲定；韓國政府將密切關注政策發展，並與美方保持緊密溝通，爭取避免相關措施對韓國企業造成不利影響。

美國商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)日前表示，川普政府正研議提高外國晶片進口關稅，課徵範圍可能由半導體本身擴大至含有晶片的產品，包括數據中心伺服器及消費電子設備，但在美國設廠生產的企業可能獲得豁免。三星電子及SK海力士雖已在美國規劃或推動投資，大量產能仍集中於韓國，最終豁免標準、適用產品及在美投資門檻，將直接牽動兩家晶片大廠的成本與生產布局。

news.Title: 台積電難撐！台股殺尾收盤跌307點 南電、南亞科殺盤戰犯
news.Content:
美債殖利率回落，緩解市場對通膨的擔憂，美股主要指數週三收高，台股今（3）日一度漲逾350點，最高來到46517.45點，隨後震盪翻黑後失守4萬6大關，雖然一度翻紅，但接近尾盤賣單再度湧現，收盤跌307.06點以45857.66點作收，成交量9463億。

台積電早盤力撐盤勢，尾盤漲勢收斂，漲5元收在2395元。聯發科及台達電逆勢收紅，紛紛漲1.52%及 1.73%，機器人概念股續強，盟立亮燈漲停。

弱勢股方面，載板大廠南電傳出可能不調漲第四季BT載板價格，衝擊股價摜殺跌停，衝擊同集團南亞下挫逾6%。PCB成重災區，尖點跌停，景碩跌逾8%，金像電跌近6%。

南亞科公布2026年8月自結合併營收446.9億元，月增1.88％、年增560.85％，再創單月歷史新高，但湧現獲利了結賣壓，收盤跌逾7%。拖累記憶體股大跌，華邦電跌逾5%，旺宏跌逾4%。

被動元件股走弱，國巨急跌逾5%，華新科跌逾7%。欣興涉嫌「洗產地」疑慮，今早盤上漲逾3%至1005元，重返千元大關，但隨後股價翻黑急挫，收盤跌幅逾5%。

永豐投顧分析，台股短線震盪，不建議追價，長線布局較為穩健；美股同時面臨較差的9月季節性效應，後續仍需留意非農就業數據。

美股道瓊上漲295.07點或0.56%，收53,061.95點。S&P500上漲35.13點或0.46%，收7,666.60點。NASDAQ上漲118.05點或0.45%，收26,217.83點。費城半導體上漲50.64點或0.45%，收11,339.25點。

天候不佳，拖累UNIQLO日本同店銷售陷入萎縮。UNIQLO營運商迅銷(Fast Retailing、9983.JP)今日股價大跌。

根據Yahoo Finance的報價顯示，截至台北時間3日上午8點45分為止，迅銷大跌3.55%至67,900日圓，表現遠遜於大盤(東證股價指數TOPIX)的上漲0.66%。

迅銷2日於日股盤後公布資料指出，因天候不佳(颱風、豪雨)，導致來客數減少，造成夏季商品銷售不振，拖累2026年8月份日本地區UNIQLO事業728家同店銷售額(指營業超過1年以上店面、包含網購銷售額)較去年同月下滑1.3%，為3個月來第2度陷入萎縮。

8月份日本地區UNIQLO事業同店來客數較去年同月減少9.1%，連續第3個月減少；客單價(每位顧客平均消費額)增加8.6%，連續第12個月增加。

8月份日本地區UNIQLO事業整體銷售額(包含營業未滿1年在內的全部772家直營門市、不含加盟門市)較去年同月減少2.2%，3個月來第2度陷入萎縮；來客數減少10.2%，3個月來第2度呈現減少；客單價增加8.9%，連續第12個月增加。

迅銷7月9日公布財報資料指出，因UNIQLO事業業績旺，2026年度(2025年9月-2026年8月)合併營收目標自原先(4月)預估的3.9兆日圓上修至3.97兆日圓、將年增16.7%，顯示本業獲利情況的「事業利益」目標自6,900億日圓上修至7,100億日圓、將年增28.8%，合併純益目標也自4,800億日圓上修至5,000億日圓、將年增15.5%，純益將連續第6年創下歷史新高紀錄。

news.Title: 1分鐘讀財經》不是南亞科、華邦電！AI推論爆發 大摩點名「2檔記憶體」驚見1666元天價
news.Content:
小編今天（3）日精選5件國內外重要財經大事。摩根士丹利證券參加SEMICON Taiwan指出，記憶體產業的價值創造正從過去單純追求位元微縮，逐步轉向架構層級的創新，在AI發展加速環境中，記憶體正逐漸成為系統層級的關鍵差異化因素，看好愛普*（6531）、旺宏（2337）前景，均給予「優於大盤」投資評等，推測合理股價1,666元與220元。

【1】記憶體熱 大摩按讚愛普、旺宏

摩根士丹利證券指出，在目前2.5D架構之後，3D堆疊很可能成為未來的主要發展趨勢。三星的zHBM與更廣泛的DRAM-on-Logic概念，皆顯示記憶體正從配置在運算晶片旁，逐步走向與晶片垂直整合的架構，如此一來，混合鍵合、WoW整合與散熱共同設計重要性都將進一步提升；大摩看好，愛普*有望成為新興3D WoW堆疊商機的潛在受惠者。

【2】南亞科8月營收再攀新高

DRAM景氣持續火熱，南亞科（2408）2日公布2026年8月自結合併營收446.9億元，月增1.88％、年增560.85％，再創單月歷史新高；累計今年前八月營收2,201.94億元，較去年同期大增638.19％，營運動能持續升溫。

【3】利空夾擊 外資砍台股913億

萬寶投顧總監蔡明彰表示，目前全球主要經濟體公債殖利率飆升，公債殖利率風暴為9月最大黑天鵝。其中，美10年公債殖利率若再往5％靠攏且費半指數失守半年線，台股不排除面臨補跌壓力。

【4】馬斯克估人形機器人 十年內上看10億台

G20（20國集團）創新部長級會議1日於北卡羅來納州登場，來自世界各地的官員與科技業高層齊聚一堂，討論AI革命帶來的顛覆與機會。億萬富豪馬斯克在會中表示，AI可能會讓全球經濟規模增加20％～30％，未來十年內人形機器人數量至少達10億台。

【5】美伊激烈交火 油價衝向百美元

美國與伊朗1日爆發7月以來最激烈交火，美軍對伊朗多個目標發動空襲，伊朗隨即攻擊美軍數座中東基地，消息帶動國際油價躥揚，布蘭特原油一度升破97美元，市場擔憂衝突升溫恐讓油價突破100美元大關。中東動盪拖累全球股市軟腳，日韓股市跌勢尤其明顯，日股狂瀉近1,900點，韓股重挫4％。

news.Title: 外資連兩週買進日債，上週淨買5091億日圓，日股轉獲小幅加碼
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】日本財務省週四公布，截至8月28日止當週，外資淨買進日本債券5,091億日圓，高於前一週的4,352億日圓，連續第二週呈現淨買超，顯示日本債券殖利率攀升後，對海外資金的吸引力有所增強。股票方面，外資當週淨買進日本股票358億日圓，扭轉前一週淨賣出7,641億日圓的局面。不過，買入力道仍相當有限，反映日圓波動、日本央行升息預期及全球科技股震盪，持續壓抑海外投資人擴大日股部位的意願。

日本投資人海外配置則呈現分歧。當週淨賣出海外債券8,240億日圓，雖較前一週淨賣出1兆9,784億日圓明顯收斂，但已連續兩週撤出海外債市，可能反映全球長債殖利率急升及匯率避險成本偏高，促使資金降低海外債券曝險。

另一方面，日本投資人當週淨買進海外股票358億日圓，較前一週淨賣出8,690億日圓明顯改善。整體數據顯示，資金流向由前一週全面偏向撤離風險資產，轉為小幅回補股票；債券資金則呈現外資加碼日本債、國內投資人續賣海外債的明顯對比。

news.Title: Is Analog Devices Stock Outperforming the Nasdaq?
news.Content:
Wilmington, Massachusetts-based Analog Devices, Inc. (ADI) designs, manufactures, tests, and markets integrated circuits (ICs), software, and subsystems products. Valued at $171.8 billion by market cap, the company's products are used in communications, computer, industrial, instrumentation, military, aerospace, automotive, and high-performance consumer electronics applications.

Companies worth $10 billion or more are generally described as "large-cap stocks," and ADI definitely fits that description, with its market cap exceeding this threshold, reflecting its substantial size, influence, and dominance in the semiconductors industry. ADI commands a strong competitive position in high-performance analog and mixed-signal semiconductors, underpinned by its global leadership in data converters. Its moat is built on a deep proprietary IP portfolio, entrenched relationships in high-margin industrial, automotive and healthcare markets, and expanded signal-chain and power management capabilities from strategic acquisitions. The company further benefits from a resilient hybrid manufacturing model and strong pricing power, supported by the long, sticky lifecycles typical of critical analog components.

Shares of ADI rose 30.7% on a YTD basis and climbed 41.1% over the past 52 weeks, outperforming NASX's YTD gains of 12.3% and 21.7% returns over the last year.

To confirm the bullish trend, ADI has been trading above its 200-day moving average over the past year, with slight fluctuations. However, the stock is trading below its 50-day moving average since late June, with minor fluctuations.

ADI's outperformance reflects broad-based and strengthening demand for its analog solutions, increasingly tied to AI. While data center remains the primary growth driver today, its build-out and adoption are still in the early stages, and industrial demand is also gaining momentum. With strength expected to persist across segments, the AI-led semiconductor supercycle appears well-positioned to play out over multiple years.

Story Continues

On Aug. 19, ADI shares closed down marginally after reporting its Q3 results. Its adjusted EPS of $3.45 surpassed Wall Street expectations of $3.33. The company's revenue was $4 billion, topping Wall Street forecasts of $3.9 billion. For Q4, ADI expects its adjusted EPS to range from $3.71 to $4.01, and revenue in the range of $4.2 billion to $4.4 billion.

In the competitive arena of semiconductors, Texas Instruments Incorporated (TXN) has taken the lead over the stock, with a 46% gain on a YTD basis, but lagged behind the stock, with a 25.1% uptick over the past 52 weeks.

Wall Street analysts are bullish on ADI's prospects. The stock has a consensus "Strong Buy" rating from the 32 analysts covering it, and the mean price target of $463.35 suggests a notable potential upside of 30.7% from current price levels.

news.Title: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold AMAT Stock After a 72.5% YTD Rise?
news.Content:
Applied Materials AMAT shares have climbed 72.5% year to date (YTD), outperforming the Zacks Computer and Technology sector and the Zacks Electronics - Semiconductors industry's appreciation of 16.8% and 26.1%, respectively.

AMAT YTD Performance Chart

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

The rise in stock price has made AMAT stock trade at a premium. Currently, AMAT has a price-to-sales (P/S) multiple of 8.04X, which is much above the industry's P/S of 4.96X. AMAT's value score of D also suggests its overvaluation.

AMAT Forward 12-Month (P/S) Valuation Chart

Given the rise in share price and valuation combination, investors might ask: Should they buy, sell or hold the stock? Let's discuss the fundamentals in detail.

AI and Capacity Expansion Trends Strengthen AMAT's Growth

Applied Materials is well positioned to capitalize on AI-driven semiconductor demand as leading-edge foundry-logic, DRAM and advanced packaging are expected to account for around 80% of wafer fab equipment growth in 2026 and 2027. AMAT's leadership in these areas, particularly HBM and 3D chiplet stacking, strengthens its exposure to rising AI computing requirements and fab capacity investments globally.

AMAT introduced six new chipmaking systems in the latest quarter, spanning DRAM and advanced packaging. Enhanced Centura Prime Epi targets faster, more power-efficient DRAM and HBM, while Producer Avila 2 supports higher-layer-count HBM. AMAT also introduced Opta Quad CMP, Nokota VMax 2 ECD, and new eBeam systems addressing demanding packaging, plating, metrology and defect-analysis requirements for advanced architectures and yield optimization across fabs.

As the opportunity broadens beyond equipment sales, chipmakers race to increase output and yield, benefiting wafer fabrication equipment manufacturers like AMAT. Applied Materials expects advanced packaging revenues to grow more than 70% in calendar 2026, while DRAM revenues, including HBM packaging, rose 52% year over year in the fiscal third quarter. Process diagnostics and control revenues are also expected to increase more than 50% this year overall through 2026.

Furthermore, Applied Global Services (AGS) adds an important recurring growth engine. AGS generated record third-quarter revenues of $1.78 billion, up 22% year over year, with gross margin reaching 35.6% and operating margin at 30.1%. Since more than 37,000 chambers are connected to AIx software, supporting AI-powered monitoring, diagnostics and predictive analytics, AGS is expected to grow above 20% in 2026 further and improve profitability.

Story Continues

Strong customer visibility further supports AMAT's growth outlook. Most leading-edge logic and DRAM fabs are operating at full capacity, customers announced more than 10 new fab projects during the third quarter of fiscal 2026, and some forecasts extend to 2030. AMAT plans to double quarterly system output by 2028. Applied Materials' fiscal fourth-quarter revenue guidance of $10.25 billion also signals accelerating momentum into 2027.

AMAT's Broad Portfolio Helps it Challenge its Competitors

AMAT's broad portfolio positions the company to capture a larger share of customer spending as semiconductor manufacturing becomes increasingly materials-intensive while also keeping its competitors like KLA Corporation KLAC, Lam Research LRCX and Camtek CAMT at bay. The breadth of Applied Materials' portfolio also reduces its dependence on any single semiconductor technology cycle and supports stronger pricing power.

KLA Corporation remains a dominant player in process control, wafer inspection and yield management solutions, while Camtek focuses on semiconductor inspection, metrology, advanced packaging and high-performance computing applications. Lam Research competes with Applied Materials across deposition and etch technologies, including advanced atomic layer deposition systems used in leading-edge semiconductor manufacturing.

All of these companies operate based on large capital expenditures. AMAT is particularly seeing strong customer visibility. Based on longer-term customer demand signals, the company opened its newest manufacturing center in Singapore during the quarter. AMAT is hiring and training manufacturing and customer-support personnel with the objective of doubling quarterly system output from current levels by 2028.

Continuous competitive environments require continued execution because customers can standardize around fewer toolsets or negotiate across broad equipment purchases. The competitive environment also pressures margin, but AMAT's value-based pricing has supported its bottom line. For the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, Applied Materials expects non-GAAP earnings of $4.02 per share (+/- 20 cents), indicating 85% year-over-year growth at the midpoint. The Zacks Consensus Estimate reflects year-over-year growth of 86.6%. The estimates have been revised upward in the past 30 days.

Conclusion: Buy AMAT Stock Now

AMAT's broad portfolio, rising AI-driven WFE demand, expanding semiconductor equipment business and investments in manufacturing capacity support further growth. Therefore, investors should consider buying AMAT stock for long-term growth potential. Given these factors, we suggest investors accumulate this Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) stock at present. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here .

news.Title: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights MACOM Technology, Monolithic Power and Semtech
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – September 2, 2026 – Today, Zacks Equity Research discusses MACOM Technology MTSI, Monolithic Power MPWR and Semtech Corp. SMTC.

Industry: Analog Mixed-Signal Semiconductors

Link: https://www.zacks.com/commentary/2983350/buy-analog-mixed-signal-players-macom-monolithic-semtech

The analog/mixed-signal semiconductor market is poised for solid growth this year, following a strong 2025. Macro and geopolitical developments remain overhangs, with capacity constraints in certain mature and specialty processes increasingly tightening supply and supporting prices.

We expect that these concerns will be overridden by the cyclical recovery in semiconductors coupled with strong end market demand from AI, industrial automation and automotive. We think there may be significant opportunities here and our bets are particularly on MACOM Technology , Monolithic Power and Semtech Corp. .

2026 growth data from World Semiconductor Trade Statistics (WSTS) – provided in Spring 2026 – projects 90% growth in semiconductors this year, mainly driven by memory, which is expected to grow around 250%. The analog segment is expected to grow a relatively sedate 10% because of its greater exposure to the industrial and auto markets. However, the recovery in these markets, along with AI-related demand, is providing additional support.

While valuations appear rich compared to the broader tech sector as well as the S&P benchmark, risk appears limited given the significant growth levers that could support multi-year expansion.

About the Industry

The electronic gadgets we use to accurately read our commands, and record, store, retrieve and process the information we throw at them run on semiconductor technology, whether analog (enabling the recording and measurement of real-world information), digital (processing information available in machine-readable language) or mixed signal (enabling conversion of analog signals to digital or digital to analog among other things). Most electronic gadgets use a combination of these components, whether in consumer, industrial, auto, medical, communications, or IoT and other markets.

The industry is cyclical and prices are elastic. Players usually serve multiple markets that offset their individual seasonality, or focus on certain core markets for which they have highly differentiated technology and relationships.

Growth Prospects Strong Despite Macro and Geopolitics

The rapid growth of artificial intelligence and data-center infrastructure has emerged as an increasingly important growth driver for the analog and mixed-signal semiconductor industry. AI computing is increasing demand not only for GPUs and memory but also for the supporting semiconductor infrastructure required to power, connect and control increasingly dense computing systems. AI data centers require sophisticated power-management and power-delivery solutions, high-speed signal conditioning, optical and electrical connectivity, timing components and thermal-management technologies. As AI clusters scale, rising power consumption and increasing data-transfer speeds are driving greater semiconductor content per system, creating significant opportunities for suppliers of analog, mixed-signal, power and high-speed connectivity products.

Analog and mixed-signal semiconductor demand continues to be driven by several powerful and interconnected secular trends . Foremost among them is the rapid electrification of transportation, particularly the rise of electric vehicles , which significantly increases demand for analog components such as power management ICs, battery monitoring systems and sensor interfaces. Closely related is the expansion of IoT and edge devices , where billions of connected nodes rely on mixed-signal chips with ultra-low power consumption. Industrial automation is another major driver, as smart factories and Industry 4.0 applications depend heavily on precise sensing, control systems and predictive maintenance enabled by these technologies. In parallel, the rollout of 5G and advanced connectivity infrastructure is fueling demand for high-performance RF components, data converters and timing solutions that rely on mixed-signal integration. Additionally, the global energy transition is accelerating the need for advanced power management systems in renewable energy, EV charging and smart grid applications, making power analog the largest segment in the market. While consumer electronics continue to contribute, their growth has matured, shifting focus from volume expansion to increased functionality per device, which still raises analog content. While elevated memory prices are likely to pressure consumer electronics and other memory-intensive applications, AI infrastructure spending is increasingly offsetting this weakness. Consequently, the outlook for analog and mixed-signal semiconductors is becoming increasingly differentiated by end market rather than being uniformly cyclical.

In general, semiconductor pricing is robust when capacity is tight and utilization high. Companies start adding capacity when they anticipate the next big growth cycle which usually continues for several years. AI is a major driver of the current build cycle and AI demand is expected to remain strong for years to come, lengthening the cycle and supporting prices. Supply chain efficiency also has an effect on chip prices. The significant increase in chip demand is driven by AI, data centers, IoT and EVs and strategic imperatives for countries in the race to technological superiority. However, capacity constraints are becoming increasingly evident in certain mature and specialty processes, including 200mm manufacturing platforms commonly used for analog, power and other mature-node semiconductor products. AI-related demand is competing for some of the same manufacturing resources, and foundries are also reallocating capacity toward higher-margin products. Therefore, pricing should remain relatively resilient in the foreseeable future, particularly for differentiated products and those facing capacity constraints.

The push toward greater system integration and application-specific solutions is significantly reshaping the analog/mixed-signal industry. The need to reduce system cost, power consumption and physical footprint is driving companies to integrate analog, digital, sensing, processing and connectivity functions into highly integrated solutions. This shift is being enabled by advanced process technologies like CMOS scaling and specialized nodes (for example SOI and BiCMOS). This raises the technical complexity of design, especially in noise isolation, signal integrity and mixed-signal verification, increasing development time and demand for specialized analog design talent. It can also increase the value per chip, as customers pay more for integrated solutionsthat reduce system complexity and development costs. Leading analog and mixed-signal companies like TXN, ADI, Infineon, STM and NXP are increasingly developing highly integrated, application-specific solutions, particularly in automotive, industrial and communications markets.

Story Continues

Zacks Industry Rank Indicates Strong Growth Prospects

The Zacks Semiconductor – Analog and Mixed industry is housed within the broader Zacks Computer and Technology sector. It carries a Zacks Industry Rank of #23, which places it in the top 9% of the nearly 250 Zacks-classified industries. The group's Zacks Industry Rank, which is basically the average of the Zacks Rank of all the member stocks, indicates improving near-term prospects.

Our research shows that the top 50% of the Zacks-ranked industries outperforms the bottom 50% by a factor of more than 2 to 1. The industry's positioning in the top 50% of Zacks-ranked industries is based on the earnings outlook of the constituent companies in aggregate. Looking at the aggregate earnings estimate revisions over the past year, we see that 2026 estimates have been rising more or less steadily over the past year, though more significantly so in the last four months.

For 2027 as well, the more significant increases have come in the last four months. Overall, the 2026 estimate has increased 34.6% over the past year, while the 2027 estimate has increased 32.5%.

Before we present a few stocks that you may want to consider for your portfolio, let's take a look at the industry's recent stock-market performance and valuation picture.

Stock Market Performance Shows Solid Returns

The Semiconductor – Analog and Mixed industry currently trades at a premium to both the broader Zacks Computer and Technology sector and the S&P 500.

Overall, the industry has gained 37.4% over the past year while the broader sector gained 29.9% and the S&P 500 gained 20.8%.

Industry's Current Valuation a Premium

On the basis of forward 12-month price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio, the industry is trading at a 23.22X multiple, which is a 17.5% discount to its median value over the past year. It is however a 12.4% premium to the broader market's 20.65X as well as a 15.5% premium to the S&P 500's 20.1X.

The industry has traded between the 23.22X and 36.39X multiples over the past year.

3 Stocks Worth Buying

Despite growing macro uncertainty, a cyclical recovery and strong industrial and AI demand are serving as powerful tailwinds for the industry. The following stocks are worth a closer look:

MACOM Technology Solutions : Headquartered in Lowell, Massachusetts, MACOM designs and manufactures high-performance semiconductor products for the data center, telecommunications, and industrial and defense markets. MACOM's semiconductor solutions are used across high-speed optical networking, wireless infrastructure, radar, aerospace and defense, and high-performance computing applications.

The company is benefiting from strong AI infrastructure demand, an expanding optical connectivity portfolio and emerging opportunities in satellite communications. A key growth driver is the rapid buildout of AI data centers, which require increasingly high-speed, low-latency connections between processors, switches and other components. MACOM supplies critical optical and analog components used in these connectivity systems, positioning it as an important semiconductor supplier to AI networking infrastructure. The company is expanding its exposure to higher-speed optical technologies, with solutions supporting 800G and 1.6T connectivity and emerging 3.2T architectures.

MACOM is also expanding its opportunity in satellite communications, particularly as low-Earth orbit (LEO) networks drive demand for higher-frequency and higher-bandwidth connectivity. Its RF and optical solutions support satellite communications, providing an additional growth opportunity beyond traditional telecommunications and data centers.

That said, MACOM's growth is increasingly tied to the AI data-center investment cycle, creating exposure to a potentially cyclical and concentrated market. Its dependence on hyperscalers could amplify this risk, as delays or reductions in customer capital spending could materially affect demand. Competition in optical connectivity could pressure pricing and margins as higher-speed technologies become more standardized. The company also faces execution risks as it ramps 1.6T and 3.2T products, particularly as competition intensifies in next-generation optical connectivity. Meanwhile, satellite communications remains an emerging opportunity and is not yet a significant contributor to revenue.

MACOM's third quarter earnings beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 4.5%. The estimates for fiscal years 2026 and 2027 (ending September) are up 45 cents (9.1%) and $1.49 (22.7%), respectively, in the last 30 days. This represents revenue and earnings growth of a respective 36.8% and 55% in 2026 and 35.8% and 49.7% in 2027.

Shares of this Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) company have appreciated 105.8% in the past year.

Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. : Headquartered in Kirkland, Washington, Monolithic is a fabless semiconductor company that develops high-performance power-management and power-conversion solutions. The company serves a diversified range of markets, including storage and computing, enterprise data, automotive, communications, consumer and industrial applications.

MPWR is increasingly positioned to benefit from the rapid rise in power requirements across AI infrastructure and other high-performance computing applications, with recent results indicating a significant acceleration in demand. Total revenue increased 47.6% year over year in the second quarter of 2026, highlighting the strength of the company's overall growth trajectory. Enterprise Data revenue surged 164.3% year over year in the quarter, on the back of 97.7% growth in quarter one, after declining 2% in 2025.

The sharp rebound reflects accelerating demand for AI and server power-management solutions, positioning Enterprise Data as an increasingly important growth driver for the company. As AI servers require increasingly dense and efficient power delivery, the company stands to benefit from rising power content per system as it develops more compact, high-power and efficient solutions, advanced packaging technologies and next-generation architectures such as 800V data-center power.

Importantly, growth extends beyond AI: communications revenue was up 78.3% in the quarter, while automotive and industrial increased 8.2% and 17.3%, respectively. In 2025, automotive revenue grew 43.1%, communications 36.8%, storage and computing 46.0% and industrial 35.3%. This diversification implies multiple secular growth avenues while reducing reliance on any single market. Its increasingly integrated power solutions and modules can further increase content per system across served markets, strengthening customer relationships and supporting the company's long-term growth opportunity.

Given the recent growth trajectory, expectations for AI-driven growth have risen sharply, increasing the risk of disappointment if data-center capital spending slows or is delayed. Sustaining triple-digit Enterprise Data growth will also become more difficult as the base expands, while customer concentration and dependence on large hyperscalers could make revenue growth more volatile if customers alter their spending plans.

The company faces additional execution risks as it ramps next-generation architectures such as 800V data-center power. Competition remains intense, while a premium valuation leaves limited room for execution shortfalls and could result in significant multiple compression if AI growth moderates.

Monolithic Power's second quarter earnings beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 10.5%. The estimates for fiscal years 2026 and 2027 (ending December) are up $2.93 (12.1%) and $4.88 (16.3%), respectively, in the last 30 days. This works out to expected revenue and earnings growth of 46.4% and 52.6% in 2026 and 26.3% and 28.1% in 2027.

Shares of the Zacks Rank #1 company have appreciated 51.7% in the past year.

Semtech Corporation : Camarillo, California-based Semtech is a semiconductor and connectivity company providing high-performance solutions for data centers, communications infrastructure, industrial applications and IoT. Its portfolio spans high-speed signal-integrity products for optical and copper data communications, analog and mixed-signal solutions, and wireless connectivity technologies including LoRa®. The company also provides IoT modules, gateways and connectivity solutions supporting cellular and other wireless networks.

Semtech is benefiting from improving demand across its data-center, industrial and IoT businesses, with recent results showing accelerating growth and expanding margins. Data-center revenue increased 91% year over year in the latest quarter, outpacing 33% growth in total company revenue, as AI-driven increases in bandwidth and connectivity requirements support demand for its optical and connectivity products. FiberEdge and CopperEdge products position the company to benefit from rising bandwidth requirements, as increasingly demanding applications drive higher component content per system.

Beyond data centers, LoRa-enabled solutions are supporting growth in industrial and IoT applications by providing low-power, long-range connectivity for connected devices and infrastructure. The improving growth profile is translating into stronger operating leverage, with Q2 FY2027 adjusted operating margin expanding to 24.4% from 18.8% a year earlier.

The combination of accelerating data-center demand, expanding content per system, growing IoT adoption and strong margin expansion provides a solid foundation for sustained earnings growth.The stock increasingly reflects the AI/data-center opportunity but must execute successfully on a rapid transition toward higher-speed optical connectivity. At the same time, it remains meaningfully exposed to cyclical markets. If AI spending slows, the company's other businesses may not be strong enough to offset weaker data-center demand, leaving the shares vulnerable to a pullback.

Semtech topped earnings estimates in the second quarter of fiscal 2027 (ending January). The Zacks Consensus Estimate for 2027 is up 67 cents (25.2%) in the last seven days with the 2027 estimate jumping $1.56 (42.7%) in the same period. Revenue and earnings are expected to increase a respective 41.5% and 94.7% in 2027 and a respective 27.5% and 56.5% the following year.

news.Title: Is KLA Stock Outperforming the Dow?
news.Content:
Milpitas, California-based KLA Corporation (KLAC) is a technology company serving the semiconductor industry, with a market capitalization of about $229.2 billion. The company develops advanced equipment and services for inspecting and controlling manufacturing processes, helping produce wafers, integrated circuits, advanced packaging, reticles, and printed circuit boards.

Companies worth $200 billion or more are generally described as "mega-cap stocks," and KLA definitely fits that description, with its market cap exceeding this threshold, reflecting its substantial size, influence, and dominance within the Semiconductor Equipment & Materials industry.

More News from Barchart

Dear GameStop Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for September 8

SMCI vs. CoreWeave: 1 AI Infrastructure Model Has the Bigger Opportunity

Why Analysts Think Sellas Life Sciences Stock Can Gain 150% From Here

Markets move fast. Keep up by reading our FREE midday Barchart Brief newsletter for exclusive charts, analysis, and headlines.

KLA stands out for its technological leadership in semiconductor process control and yield management. Its strong market position, extending product lead times, high profitability, and relative resilience to regulatory restrictions support steady demand. The company is also gaining market share as increasingly complex chips require more inspection and metrology.

Despite its notable strengths, KLAC has slipped 44.4% from its 52-week high of $307.37, reached on June 30, 2026. Over the past three months, KLAC stock has plunged 11.9%, underperforming the Dow Jones Industrial Average's ($DOWI) 3.3% uptick during the same time frame.

Shares of KLAC have climbed 40.6% year-to-date and 96% over the past 52 weeks, considerably outperforming the Dow's 9.8% year-to-date gain and 15.9% return over the past year.

KLAC has remained above its 200-day moving average since last year, indicating a sustained long-term uptrend. However, it has dipped below its 50-day moving average since mid-July.

KLA has outperformed the broader market, supported by strong financial performance. Its revenue has grown 14.4% annually over the past five years, while its 40.6% average operating margin and 29.2% average free cash flow margin over the past two years highlight strong profitability and cash generation, giving the company greater capacity to reinvest and grow.

On July 28, KLAC shares fell about 6.2% after reporting its fiscal Q4 results. Its non-GAAP net income per share of $1.05 surpassed Wall Street expectations of $1.00, while total revenue of $3.66 billion beat forecasts of $3.61 billion.

Story Continues

In the competitive Semiconductor Equipment & Materials industry, top rival Lam Research Corporation (LRCX) has significantly outperformed KLAC, gaining 69.5% year-to-date and 189.8% over the past 52 weeks.

Wall Street analysts are moderately bullish on KLAC's prospects. The stock has a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating from the 28 analysts covering it, while the mean price target of $237.81 suggests potential upside of 39.2% from current price levels.

news.Title: 《陸股》滬指跌0.97%、日K翻黑；恆指跌0.07%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-02 17:13:56 數位內容中心 發佈

中國A股主要指數今(2)日同步走弱，整體盤勢偏弱，科技與成長族群壓力較大。上證指數收於3,941.39點，下跌0.97%，日K翻黑；深證成指收於13,611.55點，下跌1.88%；創業板指收於3,312.24點，下跌2.39%；科創50收於1,617.60點，下跌1.82%。

上證指數跌幅相對較小，反映銀行、保險等權值族群仍提供一定支撐；相較之下，深證成指與創業板指走勢明顯偏弱，顯示中小型與成長風格承壓較重，市場資金偏向防守與輪動。

通訊、半導體、元件、電子化學品與消費電子等族群表現偏弱，對創業板指與科創50形成拖累。科創50回檔，顯示科技成長方向的承接力不足，指數雖有局部反彈，仍難扭轉整體弱勢。

成交量方面，滬市今成交8,354億元(人民幣,下同)，深市成交9,558億元，兩市成交額1兆7,912億元，較前一交易日量縮約12%。

從盤面上來看，軍工族群逆勢活躍，內蒙一機、建設工業、長城軍工等個股表現突出；銀行、美容護理、培育鑽石與旅遊概念也相對活躍，成為盤面少數亮點。

相較之下，農業、有色金屬與乳業等族群轉弱，成為盤勢主要拖累，神農種業、華綠生物等農業相關個股跌幅居前，市場強弱分化明顯，資金短線仍以題材輪動為主。

港股方面，今日盤勢走弱，恆生指數收於25,311.21點，下跌18.52點或0.07%，惟日K翻紅；恆生科技指數收於4,517.16點，下跌33.72點或0.74%。盤勢受外圍市況影響，整體情緒仍偏謹慎，科技類股壓力較明顯。科網股方面，阿里巴巴與騰訊下跌，對大盤形成拖累，嗶哩嗶哩與快手亦走弱；不過，美團逆勢上漲，成為少數走強的重磅科技股。

news.Title: 《韓股》中東風險升溫 KOSPI重挫近4%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-02 16:37:36 數位內容中心 發佈

韓股今(2)日明顯走弱，韓國KOSPI指數收於6,562.72點，下跌273.08點或3.99%；韓國KOSDAQ指數收於803.98點，下跌17.27點或2.10%。盤面核心基調是風險趨避情緒升溫，美國與伊朗軍事緊張推升國際油價，也帶動美國10年期公債殖利率攀升，市場對通膨與資金成本的擔憂同步加重。

news.Title: 【公告】晶豪科 2026年8月合併營收79.05億元 年增605.24%
油價飆，升息、通膨憂慮升溫，日經週三大跌2.85%，科技、汽車股走弱
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】日本股市週三走跌，因中東緊張局勢加劇，原油價格飆升，再次引發人們對通膨和升息的擔憂。收盤時，東證第一部指數下滑100.26點或2.40%，報4,081.60點；日經225指數則是下跌1,889.70點或2.85%，報64,325.64點。

美國對伊朗發動新一輪打擊，加劇市場對荷姆茲海峽能源運輸長期受擾的擔憂，推動油價升至7月底以來最高水準。

美伊之間的緊張局勢推高了能源價格，這加劇了人們對通膨可能再次加速並推高全球利率的擔憂，對股市構成不利影響。

週三日股拋售潮波及範圍廣泛，人工智能和半導體等成長股領跌，這些股票容易受到利率上升的影響。

大和資產管理公司首席策略分析師Kazunori Tatebe表示，鑑於利率已經上升，股市尤其容易受到油價上漲擔憂的影響。

Gama Asset Management的資深宏觀投資組合經理人Rajeev De Mello指出，美伊之間新一輪的衝突及其對油價的影響，令投資者更加擔憂債券市場。債券市場的擔憂已經上升到「明顯不利於」長期科技股的程度。

T&D資產管理公司首席策略長Ito En則是表示，像豐田這樣的汽車股被認為特別容易受到中東局勢的影響，人們擔心這可能會影響銷售趨勢。

個股表現方面，專注於投資高科技領域的軟銀集團股價下跌6.42%；營收逾三成來自北美市場的汽車製造大廠豐田汽車股價下滑3.39%；金融控股業者三菱日聯金融集團股價下降0.43%；能源開採商國際石油開發帝石股價滑落1.48%。

news.Title: 台股下挫784點 台積電跌55元 華邦電、旺宏黑翻紅成功
news.Content:
台股今（2）日開低走低，下挫784點，收46164點最低，跌幅1.67%，成交量來到9100億；櫃買指數雖一度翻紅但後續走跌，終場收406.96元，跌幅3.81%。

權值股部分，台積電開低走低，尾盤4057張賣單讓股價從2395元滑落至收盤價2385元，下跌55元，跌幅2.25%，聯發科早盤一度來到4565元，大漲逾5%，不過後續翻黑下跌，終場來到4275元，下跌40元，跌幅0.93%，鴻海來到251元，下跌5元，跌幅1.95%，緯創則逆勢上漲1.92%，收185.5元；台塑化、南亞也有1~2%的漲幅。

觀察今日盤面，記憶體族群早盤遭賣壓侵襲，但後續成功翻紅，華邦電來到179元，上漲3元，漲幅1.7%，南亞科回到平盤518元，旺宏來到123元，小漲0.5元，漲幅0.41%。

PCB族群今日集體下跌，但仍有零星火種，律勝逆勢收漲停，富喬、亞電也有逾1~2%的漲幅；值得一提的是，陷入「洗產地」風波的欣興則逆勢上漲，盤中一度來到988元，終場則收973元，漲幅0.21%，成交量2.4萬張。

news.Title: Applied Materials’ stock buybacks: History & investor impact explained
news.Content:
Applied Materials has returned shareholder value through dividends, stock splits, and share repurchases . The company — which is the world's largest manufacturer of equipment, machines, and software used to build semiconductors and advanced flat-panel displays — has benefited from the recent rise in interest in artificial intelligence. Its chipmaking expertise is used in the data centers that develop AI applications.

Here's how much Applied has bought back its shares since its first repurchase authorization.

Applied Material stock buyback quick facts

First buyback: 1996 ($37 million)

Most recent buyback by fiscal year: 2025 ($4.9 billion)

Year with biggest buyback spend: 2022 ($6.1 billion)

Total historical buyback spend: $50 billion

When was Applied Materials' first stock buyback?

In January 1996, the company's board of directors authorized the repurchase of 200,000 shares of its common stock to fund stock-based employee benefit plans. For its fiscal 1996, which ended in late October and began the prior late October, Applied bought back a total of $37 million in shares.

When was the last time Applied Materials repurchased shares?

As of late August 2026, Applied repurchased $1.178 billion in shares in the nine months through July 26, 2026. For fiscal 2025, the latest reporting year, the company repurchased $4.9 billion in stock .

How much stock has Applied Materials bought back?

Applied has repurchased almost $50 billion in shares from fiscal 1996 — the first year of its stock buyback authorization — to the nine-month period ended on July 26 2026. From fiscal years 1996 to 2025, the company's average annual repurchase amount was $1.6 billion.

In general, Applied increased the size of its stock repurchases as its free cash flow (cash provided by operating activities minus capital expenditures) rose.

The company's stock repurchase-to-free cash flow ratio (which expresses the amount of free cash a company uses on stock buybacks) peaked at 2.31 (or 231%) in 2006.

More on stock buybacks:

AMD's stock buybacks explained: History, balance & outlook

Micron Technology's stock buybacks explained

Sandisk's stock buyback program explained

A ratio exceeding 1 (or 100%) indicates that a company is spending more than its free cash flow on stock buybacks. During the fiscal 1996 to 2025 period, the ratio exceeded 1 in eight different years (2002, 2005, 2006, 2008, 2015, 2018, 2019, and 2022), suggesting that Applied was aggressive in its stock buying as it spent more on repurchases than the amount of free cash it had on hand.  There were no repurchases in 2014, the only year when it bought back no shares in its buyback program.

Applied spent the most in fiscal 2022, when it bought back $6.1 billion in shares. The stock averaged $118. As of the end of August 2026, the stock was trading at $458.

Applied Materials' stock performance

As of the end of August 2026, Applied's stock had been trading at historically high levels. The stock closed at a record high of $730 on June 30, 2026. As the shares rrose in value, the company reduced the size of its repurchases in fiscal 2026.

Applied's shares gained 13,200 times from the company's IPO in 1972 through the end of August 2026.

news.Title: ARM vs. Sandisk: Comparing Steady Historical Revenue Generation Against Rapid Sequential Revenue Expansion
news.Content:
ARM: Examining the Relatively Steady Revenue Generation Trends Over the Past Year

ARM (NASDAQ:ARM) primarily generates revenue through licensing and royalty collection on its proprietary chip designs. It conceptualizes, engineers, and licenses its core processing unit (CPU) designs, system intellectual property solutions, graphics processing units (GPUs), and supplementary software development tools to original equipment makers globally.

It published its quarterly financial results while engaging with external analysts on the broader computing infrastructure landscape, and recorded an operating margin of approximately 7.6% for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

Sandisk: Tracking the Recent Acceleration in Overall Revenue Generation Trends

Sandisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) earns its revenue by designing, manufacturing, and supplying a broad and diverse array of digital storage solutions, embedded memory components, solid-state drives, and removable memory cards that rely entirely on advanced flash memory technology.

While it commenced manufacturing operations for its newest generation of flash memory at a facility in Japan and executed several regional workforce reductions, it reported an operating margin of approximately 78% for the quarter ended July 3, 2026.

Why Understanding Corporate Revenue Trajectories Matters for Everyday Retail Investors

Revenue here refers to the standardized income-statement revenue line item. Tracking this metric helps retail investors understand the absolute size and current growth trajectory of a company's operations before accounting for operating costs, corporate taxes, employee salaries, or other internal business expenses.

Foolish Take

Sandisk is on a much sharper growth trajectory, largely due to higher selling prices for its products. Demand for artificial intelligence (AI) is extremely high for high-capacity solid-state storage. The key factor to watch for Sandisk is whether its long-term supply agreements with customers can remove the historical quarter-to-quarter volatility in selling prices and drive more stable revenue generation over the next several years.

ARM's revenue shows consistent year-over-year growth, although it fell sequentially in the second quarter. While ARM is known for supplying chip designs widely used in consumer devices like smartphones, it is gaining momentum in expanding into the data center market. This will be a key source of growth for the company.

Whether Sandisk can maintain its massive revenue size and continue to grow comes down to demand and selling prices for storage products. The more long-term agreements it signs and the more the AI infrastructure boom continues, the more likely Sandisk will continue to scale its business.

news.Title: 聯電ADR1日上漲0.59美元漲幅2.97%折台股129.51元
發哥狂噴別瞎追！旗下子公司集體也瘋漲 專家冷眼撕糖衣：只有「這1檔」不是妖股
news.Content:
9月第一個交易日，台灣股市展現了強大多頭氣勢，直接奪下「最強亞股」寶座。在輝達（Nvidia）首度直接投資台灣本土企業的世紀利多點火下，加權指數全力逼近47,000點大關，成為全球市場矚目的焦點；然而，萬寶投顧總監蔡明彰指出，在本土資金瘋狂湧入背後，國際總經大潮正暗流洶湧，美債殖利率創下新高、費城半導體指數壓盤觀望，市場正屏息等待本周美國非農就業報告「多空決戰」。

台股多方在9月初順利奪回盤面主導權，回顧8月份表現，台股以6.98％的反彈幅度，上漲約3,000點，強勢壓倒韓國3.4％、日本3.03％與中國大陸4％，港股雖然單月反彈13.13％，但今年以來（YTD）累計績效仍為負1％；反觀台股，今年以來累積績效已高達上漲61％，在9月第一個交易日，歷史性地追平了長期居冠的韓股。

輝達砸千億！聯發科強強聯手跨足雲端AI

本輪多頭最核心引爆點，莫過於輝達首度直接投資台灣本土企業，並宣布認購聯發科發行的35億美元，折合新台幣約1,100億元海外無息可轉換公司債（ECB），其債券條件為5年期、票面利率0％，轉換價格為4,513元，溢價15％；轉換時程預計9月8日於新加坡掛牌，滿三個月後，在12月7日可開始轉換為普通股，完全轉換後將占聯發科股本的1.67％。

這場強強聯手，將雙方合作從原本的邊緣AI PC、智慧汽車，正式延伸至最核心的雲端AI領域，受此利多激勵，聯發科昨（1）日開盤即跳空漲停，股價距離轉換價僅剩4％的一步之遙。

激情過後 發哥集團股切忌盲目追高

蔡明彰提醒，聯發科今年以來漲幅已高達205％，遠超競爭對手邁威爾（Marvell）142％。由於ECB模式有三個月的轉換鎖定期，短線激情過後應保持冷靜，切忌盲目追高；此外，雖然聯發科集團旗下亞信（3169）、達發（6526）、九陽（ 8040）等紛紛漲停慶祝，但目前看來僅達發基本面表現較為扎實，其餘個股多屬題材性跟漲。

儘管台股反向大漲、外冷內熱，但國際市場的觀望氣氛已達頂點。作為台韓股市先行指標的費城半導體指數，今年以來雖上漲63％，但近期股價持續受到壓制在100日線以下。

美非農報告將登場 嚴防「停滯性通膨」

美國方面，本周五9月4日即將公布8月非農就業報告，市場預估新增就業人數為5.5萬人，前月即7月數據意外暴冷減少2萬多人，當時被市場視為「不升息」的利多；然而，在美國通膨已達2％目標當下，若本次就業數據持續低迷如僅剩2、3萬人，華爾街恐將轉向擔憂停滯性通膨，也就是高通膨、低就業的全面降臨，屆時將對全球股市造成劇烈衝擊。

此外，美股勞動節後的9月7日，美國預計將迎來大規模的投資級公司債發行，恐引發資金擠壓效應，排擠政府公債。

與國際行情相背離 外資調節記憶體防補跌

台股市場部分，在資金過度集中的電子股中，記憶體族群卻出現了主力資金反向調節的異象，雖然記憶體基本面普遍被看好，但蔡明彰表示，第四季記憶體可能面臨報價的「天花板」，此舉導致部分大戶採取反向操作，在大盤大漲之際，反而將資金撤出記憶體類股。

更值得警戒的是，全球四大記憶體巨頭美光（Micron）、閃迪（SanDisk）、海力士（SK Hynix）、三星（Samsung）等近期股價皆疲軟、未能創新高；然而，台股的南亞科（2408）卻在此時反向創下新高，這種與國際產業行情嚴重背離的異常走勢，暗示短線籌碼面可能過熱，投資人需密切留意隨之而來的補跌風險。

news.Title: Deutsche Bank Names 2 Stocks for AI's Next Wave
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Deutsche Bank is telling investors to look beyond GPUs for the next leg of the artificial-intelligence infrastructure boom, naming Lumentum Holdings ( NASDAQ:LITE ) and Coherent ( NYSE:COHR ) its highest-conviction AI hardware picks. Analyst Gianmarco Conti argues that lasers and optical connectivity are becoming indispensable as AI data centers scale, giving both companies exposure to infrastructure spending regardless of which chip architecture ultimately wins.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 7 Warning Signs with LITE.

Is LITE fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Lumentum and Coherent specialize in optical and photonics technologies used to move huge volumes of data through AI and cloud infrastructure. Their lasers, transceivers and related components increasingly connect GPUs, servers and networking equipment inside massive data centers, making them classic pick-and-shovel plays on AI spending.

Deutsche Bank initiated both stocks with Buy ratings, arguing their technology is required across both traditional pluggable optics and newer co-packaged optics architectures. Both are supply constrained, sold out, and raising prices, and NVDA just invested $2B in each, Conti said.

Recent results support that demand argument. Lumentum reported fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $1.01 billion and expects fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of $1.225 billion to $1.275 billion , with a non-GAAP operating margin approaching 40%.

Coherent, meanwhile, generated $2.05 billion in fiscal fourth-quarter revenue, up 34% year over year , while non-GAAP gross margin expanded to 40.2% .

Deutsche Bank also initiated Arista Networks ( NYSE:ANET ), Cisco ( NASDAQ:CSCO ) and Hewlett Packard Enterprise ( NYSE:HPE ) with Buy ratings. Arista offers another fast-growing AI networking angle: its second-quarter revenue surged 37.7% to $3.04 billion , while management guided Q3 sales to roughly $3.3 billion . Dell, A10 Networks and Ingram Micro received Hold ratings.

Investors Takeaway

For Lumentum and Coherent, the biggest issue is whether supply constraints and pricing power persist as manufacturers add capacity. Accelerating optical demand could justify premium valuations, but any slowdown in hyperscaler AI spending or faster-than-expected supply expansion could pressure margins.

Investors should closely track revenue growth, gross margins and capacity expansion . Coherent's upcoming PhotonLink launch on September 21 is another near-term catalyst, while Lumentum's fiscal Q1 results will test whether its aggressive revenue guidance is translating into sustained growth.

news.Title: Buy Analog-Mixed Signal Players MACOM, Monolithic & Semtech
news.Content:
The analog/mixed-signal semiconductor market is poised for solid growth this year, following a strong 2025. Macro and geopolitical developments remain overhangs, with capacity constraints in certain mature and specialty processes increasingly tightening supply and supporting prices.

We expect that these concerns will be overridden by the cyclical recovery in semiconductors coupled with strong end market demand from AI, industrial automation and automotive. We think there may be significant opportunity here and our bets are particularly on MACOM Technology (MTSI), Monolithic Power (MPWR) and Semtech Corp (SMTC).

2026 growth data from World Semiconductor Trade Statistics (WSTS) – provided in Spring 2026 – projects 90% growth in semiconductors this year, mainly driven by memory, which is expected to grow around 250%. The analog segment is expected to grow a relatively sedate 10% because of its greater exposure to the industrial and auto markets. However, the recovery in these markets, along with AI-related demand, is providing additional support.

While valuations appear rich compared to the broader tech sector as well as the S&P benchmark, risk appears limited given the significant growth levers that could support multi-year expansion.

About the Industry

The electronic gadgets we use to accurately read our commands, and record, store, retrieve and process the information we throw at them run on semiconductor technology, whether analog (enabling the recording and measurement of real-world information), digital (processing information available in machine-readable language) or mixed signal (enabling conversion of analog signals to digital or digital to analog among other things). Most electronic gadgets use a combination of these components, whether in consumer, industrial, auto, medical, communications, or IoT and other markets.

The industry is cyclical and prices are elastic. Players usually serve multiple markets that offset their individual seasonality, or focus on certain core markets for which they have highly differentiated technology and relationships.

Growth Prospects Strong Despite Macro and Geopolitics

The rapid growth of artificial intelligence and data-center infrastructure has emerged as an increasingly important growth driver for the analog and mixed-signal semiconductor industry. AI computing is increasing demand not only for GPUs and memory but also for the supporting semiconductor infrastructure required to power, connect and control increasingly dense computing systems. AI data centers require sophisticated power-management and power-delivery solutions, high-speed signal conditioning, optical and electrical connectivity, timing components and thermal-management technologies. As AI clusters scale, rising power consumption and increasing data-transfer speeds are driving greater semiconductor content per system, creating significant opportunities for suppliers of analog, mixed-signal, power and high-speed connectivity products.

Story Continues

Analog and mixed-signal semiconductor demand continues to be driven by several powerful and interconnected secular trends . Foremost among them is the rapid electrification of transportation, particularly the rise of electric vehicles , which significantly increases demand for analog components such as power management ICs, battery monitoring systems and sensor interfaces. Closely related is the expansion of IoT and edge devices , where billions of connected nodes rely on mixed-signal chips with ultra-low power consumption. Industrial automation is another major driver, as smart factories and Industry 4.0 applications depend heavily on precise sensing, control systems and predictive maintenance enabled by these technologies. In parallel, the rollout of 5G and advanced connectivity infrastructure is fueling demand for high-performance RF components, data converters and timing solutions that rely on mixed-signal integration. Additionally, the global energy transition is accelerating the need for advanced power management systems in renewable energy, EV charging and smart grid applications, making power analog the largest segment in the market. While consumer electronics continue to contribute, their growth has matured, shifting focus from volume expansion to increased functionality per device, which still raises analog content. While elevated memory prices are likely to pressure consumer electronics and other memory-intensive applications, AI infrastructure spending is increasingly offsetting this weakness. Consequently, the outlook for analog and mixed-signal semiconductors is becoming increasingly differentiated by end market rather than being uniformly cyclical.

In general, semiconductor pricing is robust when capacity is tight and utilization high. Companies start adding capacity when they anticipate the next big growth cycle which usually continues for several years. AI is a major driver of the current build cycle and AI demand is expected to remain strong for years to come, lengthening the cycle and supporting prices. Supply chain efficiency also has an effect on chip prices. The significant increase in chip demand is driven by AI, data centers, IoT and EVs and strategic imperatives for countries in the race to technological superiority. However, capacity constraints are becoming increasingly evident in certain mature and specialty processes, including 200mm manufacturing platforms commonly used for analog, power and other mature-node semiconductor products. AI-related demand is competing for some of the same manufacturing resources, and foundries are also reallocating capacity toward higher-margin products. Therefore, pricing should remain relatively resilient in the foreseeable future, particularly for differentiated products and those facing capacity constraints.

The push toward greater system integration and application-specific solutions is significantly reshaping the analog/mixed-signal industry. The need to reduce system cost, power consumption and physical footprint is driving companies to integrate analog, digital, sensing, processing and connectivity functions into highly integrated solutions. This shift is being enabled by advanced process technologies like CMOS scaling and specialized nodes (for example SOI and BiCMOS). This raises the technical complexity of design, especially in noise isolation, signal integrity and mixed-signal verification, increasing development time and demand for specialized analog design talent. It can also increase the value per chip, as customers pay more for integrated solutionsthat reduce system complexity and development costs. Leading analog and mixed-signal companies like TXN, ADI, Infineon, STM and NXP are increasingly developing highly integrated, application-specific solutions, particularly in automotive, industrial and communications markets.

Zacks Industry Rank Indicates Strong Growth Prospects

The Zacks Semiconductor – Analog and Mixed industry is housed within the broader Zacks Computer and Technology sector. It carries a Zacks Industry Rank of #23, which places it in the top 9% of the nearly 250 Zacks-classified industries. The group's Zacks Industry Rank, which is basically the average of the Zacks Rank of all the member stocks, indicates improving near-term prospects.

Our research shows that the top 50% of the Zacks-ranked industries outperforms the bottom 50% by a factor of more than 2 to 1. The industry's positioning in the top 50% of Zacks-ranked industries is based on the earnings outlook of the constituent companies in aggregate. Looking at the aggregate earnings estimate revisions over the past year, we see that 2026 estimates have been rising more or less steadily over the past year, though more significantly so in the last four months.

For 2027 as well, the more significant increases have come in the last four months. Overall, the 2026 estimate has increased 34.6% over the past year, while the 2027 estimate has increased 32.5%.

Before we present a few stocks that you may want to consider for your portfolio, let's take a look at the industry's recent stock-market performance and valuation picture.

Stock Market Performance Shows Solid Returns

The Semiconductor – Analog and Mixed industry currently trades at a premium to both the broader Zacks Computer and Technology sector and the S&P 500.

Overall, the industry has gained 37.4% over the past year while the broader sector gained 29.9% and the S&P 500 gained 20.8%.

Industry's Current Valuation a Premium

On the basis of forward 12-month price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio, the industry is trading at a 23.22X multiple, which is a 17.5% discount to its median value over the past year. It is however a 12.4% premium to the broader market's 20.65X as well as a 15.5% premium to the S&P 500's 20.1X.
